name: mock-authorize
description: Mock Authorize LAB: a local stand-in for PingOne Authorize. Send decisions to the built-in Mock engine from one UI, edit the rules, and see the verdict, the statements and the exact call.

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w web
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web && node --test --test-reporter=spec scripts/*.test.mjs
